{{Top|leg}}
'''Ogly''' was an individual who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. For a [[Time/Legends|time]], Ogly was a business partner of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operator [[Borrath Freelan]], and Ogly eventually began using a starship that belonged to Freelan, because the collapse of the [[Ma'Haffee Shipyard]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] had destroyed the records of Freelan's ownership of the craft. Following the Cularin system's succession from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], military patrols were increased in the system, and one one occasion, Ogly and a number of other [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] queued in their starships near to [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], waiting for permission to depart the world.
